aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.title: Executive Assistant - Booking
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summary: The Executive Assistant - Booking provides high-level support to executives by managing operational duties and travel arrangements, conducting research, preparing statistical reports, handling information requests, and performing administrative/clerical functions. These functions include preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls, travel arrangements, scheduling meetings, and heavy calendaring. Additionally, the Executive Assistant will assist the Talent Buyer with event booking, including reaching out to venues, coordinating artist availability, submitting offers, and maintaining show files. This role also involves working with ticketing and marketing teams on sale announcements and ensuring the accuracy of online announcements. The individual will handle various projects of a confidential nature as assigned by the executive. Essential Functions: Execute various projects assigned by the executive in a timely, accurate and confidential manner. May be responsible for assisting the executive with the preparation of proposals and reporting information related to artist deals, venue development and internal operation reports. Make decisions on behalf of executive. Manage daily operational duties related to the executive in a personal and professional capacity. Ensures that all documents are seen and signed in timely manner. Prepare, manage, and schedule travel arrangements for the executive and occasionally other team members. Prepare and submit the executive’s expense reports including reconciling travel. Extremely heavy calendar management for both personal and professional management; coordinating and scheduling internal and external meetings, as well as assisting with the booking of events. Reach out to venues to place calendar holds and coordinate with the availability of an artist. Submit offers to venues and agents as assigned by the executive in a timely, accurate and confidential manner. Follow up to ensure that appropriate documents are in order. Perform diverse, advanced and confidential administrative support functions including submission of artist payment and revision of contracts for vendors and artists. May assist with composing, signing and releasing routine but somewhat complex correspondence in a timely manner. Work onsite at concert and festival events on an as needed basis as an industry liaison and coordinator. Coordinate credentials for executive’s guest. Intercept issues and resolve before they reach executive. Work with ticketing and marketing on sale announcements. Confirm accuracy of online announcements and ensure they go out in a timely manner. Maintain show files. Update information if changes are made and if new information becomes available. May assist with other projects as assigned. Required Qualifications: BA/BS Degree (4-year) In a related area 4-6 years Of related work experience Executive-level support experience Experience process

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:21.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations is currently looking for a Design Engineer to join their team in Lafayette, Louisiana. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations, a subsidiary of Crest Industries, LLC., is looking to hire a Design Engineer. Design Engineers are primarily responsible for the conceptual, preliminary, and final designs of high voltage substation structures and foundations. Design Engineers are tasked with ensuring that all designs meet the requirements of the codes and standards set by regulatory bodies and customer specifications. This role is responsible for coordinating with project managers, customers, and other staff members to ensure all project requirements are met.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. Our partner is looking for a Director Planning & Scheduling (Syteline/CSI) based in Brazil. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced planning and scheduling professional to shape manufacturing planning across a growing, global organization. You will own the Sales & Operations Planning process and help align demand, supply, inventory, and production capacity. Working closely with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and executive leadership, you will influence decisions that directly impact operational performance. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on problem solving within Infor CloudSuite Industrial/Syteline. You will establish planning standards, optimize inventory and scheduling practices, and resolve complex supply and capacity challenges. As the senior subject-matter expert, you will also drive continuous improvement and help strengthen planning maturity across the organization. Own and lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (SIOP) process, coordinating stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to balance demand and supply. Analyze forecasts, inventory levels, production capacity, and customer commitments to support effective planning decisions across the product portfolio. Develop and maintain master production schedules aligned with business objectives, manufacturing capabilities, and delivery requirements. Monitor SIOP performance indicators, including forecast accuracy, safety stock levels, inventory health, and on-time delivery. Review safety stock requirements across SKUs and establish appropriate targets based on demand volatility, lead-time variability, and service-level objectives. Identify opportunities to reduce excess inventory while maintaining appropriate customer service levels and conduct regular inventory adequacy reviews. Manage lead-time reviews for raw materials, components, and finished goods, ensuring planning parameters remain accurate and current within Syteline. Monitor vendor and manufacturing performance against established lead-time standards and collaborate with Procurement on corrective actions when variances arise. Troubleshoot planning exceptions involving production bottlenecks, material shortages, capacity constraints, scheduling conflicts, and system discrepancies. Monitor Syteline alerts and exception reports, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions with Operations, Production, and Procurement teams. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase planning accuracy, improve system utilization, and strengthen manufacturing planning processes. Serve as the senior authority on planning and scheduling, advising executive leadership on capacity strategy, planning risks, and process maturity. Establish and document planning processes, standards, and best practices while mentoring and developing other planning professionals. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. At least 7 years of progressive experience as a Master Scheduler or in a comparable senior planning and scheduling role within manufacturing, supply chain, or operations. Hands-on experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial/Syteline , including strong knowledge of its planning, scheduling, and MRP functionality. Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory management, master production scheduling, and S&OP/SIOP processes. Practical knowledge of lead-time management, safety stock calculations, production scheduling, and manufacturing workflows. Experience in medical device, biopharmaceutical, life sciences, or another FDA/ISO-regulated manufacturing environment is preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c441f3c6-d2a7-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c441f3c6-d2a7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Switzerland. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality
